integrity: The proof is symbolic for every positive integer coefficient. Exact arithmetic experiments provide finite corroboration only. Historical priority has no independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only parity of increments is fully determined; exact 2-adic valuations for odd coefficients are not asserted; prime increments remain open. The K=2 binary staircase is known from the source article; all-K parity phase diagram may have unindexed antecedents.
title: A complete binary phase diagram for weighted LCM recurrences
